description: Land Acquisition - Ahugammana, Mahara D/S Division, Gampaha District
categorisation: This gazette content is primarily about land acquisition under the Land Acquisition Act. It contains a ministerial order directing the acquisition of specific land parcels with detailed descriptions of the properties, their boundaries, and extents. While it mentions a minister's name (Nalaka Jude Harin Fernando), the core content focuses on land matters rather than government personnel changes or portfolio responsibilities. The document falls under "Land and property-related matters" as defined in Type 4.
